summary: First testing iteration for Reparatur-Verwaltung Berlin ERP MVP. Executed 25 backend pytest cases (auth, stats, seeded data counts, RBAC, orders CRUD/status flow, reject flow, media upload, chat messages) and full Playwright E2E covering all 15 features in the review request. Backend: 25/25 passing. Frontend: all critical flows working including German UI, DSGVO PII masking for TECHNIKER, WebSocket chat, receipt modal with QR/Auftragsnummer, order lifecycle, role-based route protection.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warning (likely React StrictMode double-mount in dev). Chat still works – message persists and chat-status shows 'Verbunden'. Not a functional blocker.

verified_features: MITARBEITER (mohini) & TECHNIKER (chris) login work with Repair2026!
Wrong password shows German login-error: 'E-Mail oder Passwort ist falsch'; /api/auth/register returns 404 (no public registration)
ADMIN creates order via /auftrag/neu; Auftragsnummer RB-2026-##### generated; QR shown; navigates to detail
Order list shows created orders; row click opens detail
Abholschein 80mm receipt modal opens with Auftragsnummer + QR
Assign technician sets status to ZUGEWIESEN (verified via backend)
TECHNIKER: dashboard loads; Orders list & OrderDetail do NOT expose customer_name/phone/email/address; DSGVO notice visible; accept/start-repair/mark-ready all work; reject flow tested via backend
Realtime chat: sending message via chat-input/chat-send persists and appears; chat-status=Verbunden
MITARBEITER: mark-delivered flow available (backend RBAC 200/403 based on branch)
Inventory: ADMIN sees seeded items (44 in DB confirmed via API), MITARBEITER read-only (add-inventory-button absent)
Users: ADMIN sees 10 seeded users, add/delete via UI works; MITARBEITER redirected from /benutzer to /
Scan: manual-lookup with valid Auftragsnummer navigates to detail
SLA metric & list render without errors (0 breaches on fresh orders)
Media upload via /orders/{id}/media returns storage_path (backend verified)
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt hashes correctly (starts with $2b$). httpOnly cookies set with SameSite=None; Secure. Brute-force lockout after 5 fails per (ip,email) with 15min lock — implemented.
CORS in server.py uses FRONTEND_URL from .env (single origin, allow_credentials=True). Good — no wildcard with credentials.
routes.py: serialize_order properly excludes PII fields for techniker role (DSGVO). Verified live.

MITARBEITER role has read access to /api/users (list_users line 139). Spec says Users page is admin-only in UI (which is enforced), but the API endpoint also permits mitarbeiter to list users. This is slightly broader than described but not a functional bug since UI redirects. Consider tightening to admin-only if strict role separation is required.
routes.py update_status: mitarbeiter can only set ABGEHOLT — matches requirement. Techniker limited to IN_BEARBEITUNG/FERTIG — correct.
WebSocket auth via ?token query param works; on invalid token closes with 4401. Good.
MongoDB _id properly converted to string id in all serializers; no ObjectId leaking to JSON.
seed.py auto-updates admin password if changed (per spec) — not directly re-tested but login works with Repair2026!.
test_credentials: admin@repair.de / mohini@repair.de / chris@repair.de – all password Repair2026!
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test orders (RB-2026-00003 and reject-flow order) via API; created & deleted 1 TEST user during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, seeded counts, RBAC, order lifecycle, reject, media upload, messages. Use pytest -v to re-run. All 25 tests pass. Frontend Playwright flow validated all data-testids listed in review request. WebSocket wss:// path /api/ws/{id}?token=<jwt> works. No blockers found.
